spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m3p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Dispatchers, Calls, Slots, MaxTerm

NoLeader == "noleader"
FreeSlot == "free"
NoSlot == "noslot"

VARIABLES term, leader, bookedFor, takenUp, net

vars == <<term, leader, bookedFor, takenUp, net>>

Grants == [call : Calls, slot : Slots, term : 0..MaxTerm]

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Dispatchers \union {NoLeader}
    /\ bookedFor \in [Slots -> Calls \union {FreeSlot}]
    /\ takenUp \in [Calls -> Slots \union {NoSlot}]
    /\ net \subseteq Grants

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ bookedFor = [s \in Slots |-> FreeSlot]
    /\ takenUp = [k \in Calls |-> NoSlot]
    /\ net = {}

ElectDispatcher(d) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ leader' = d
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookedFor, takenUp, net>>

FailDispatcher ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ leader' = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, bookedFor, takenUp, net>>

BookSlot(k, s) ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ bookedFor[s] = FreeSlot
    /\ takenUp[k] = NoSlot
    /\ \A g \in net : g.call # k
    /\ bookedFor' = [bookedFor EXCEPT ![s] = k]
    /\ net' = net \union {[call |-> k, slot |-> s, term |-> term]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, takenUp>>

AcceptGrant(g) ==
    /\ g \in net
    /\ g.term = term
    /\ bookedFor[g.slot] = g.call
    /\ takenUp[g.call] = NoSlot
    /\ takenUp' = [takenUp EXCEPT ![g.call] = g.slot]
    /\ net' = net \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, bookedFor>>

DiscardGrant(g) ==
    /\ g \in net
    /\ \/ g.term # term
       \/ bookedFor[g.slot] # g.call
       \/ takenUp[g.call] # NoSlot
    /\ net' = net \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, bookedFor, takenUp>>

ReleaseSlot(k) ==
    /\ takenUp[k] # NoSlot
    /\ bookedFor' = [bookedFor EXCEPT ![takenUp[k]] = FreeSlot]
    /\ takenUp' = [takenUp EXCEPT ![k] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, net>>

RevokeBooking(s) ==
    /\ bookedFor[s] # FreeSlot
    /\ takenUp[bookedFor[s]] # s
    /\ \A g \in net : g.slot # s
    /\ bookedFor' = [bookedFor EXCEPT ![s] = FreeSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, takenUp, net>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Dispatchers : ElectDispatcher(d)
    \/ FailDispatcher
    \/ \E k \in Calls, s \in Slots : BookSlot(k, s)
    \/ \E g \in Grants : AcceptGrant(g)
    \/ \E g \in Grants : DiscardGrant(g)
    \/ \E k \in Calls : ReleaseSlot(k)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : RevokeBooking(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TakenSlotIsBookedForItsCall ==
    \A k \in Calls : takenUp[k] # NoSlot => bookedFor[takenUp[k]] = k

====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper assigns shaft time slots to waiting hall calls.
One dispatcher at a time is the elected leader, and leadership carries a term
number that advances with each election until the term counter reaches its
ceiling, after which elections install a new dispatcher under the standing term.
The installed leader can fail at any point, leaving the bank leaderless until the
next election.

Each slot records the call it is booked for, or that it is free, and each call
records the slot it has actually taken up, or that it has none. The leader books
a free slot for a call that holds no slot and has no grant already travelling: the
slot is marked as booked for that call immediately, and a grant message naming the
call, the slot, and the current term is put on the network.

The network gives no ordering guarantee, so grants sit in flight and are picked up
in any order the bank likes. When a grant is picked up, it is accepted only if its
term is still the current term, the slot it names is still booked for the call it
names, and that call has not already taken up a slot; acceptance records the slot
as the call's own. A grant that fails any of those checks is discarded.

A call that has taken up a slot can release it, freeing the slot and clearing the
call's record. The leader can also revoke a booking on a slot that its call never
took up, but only once no grant for that slot is still in flight, so a booking is
never pulled out from under a grant that is about to be accepted.

The complete set of actions is: elect a dispatcher, fail the installed dispatcher,
book a free slot for a call and put a grant on the network, accept a grant that
still passes all its checks, discard a grant that does not, release a slot a call
has taken up, and revoke an untaken booking once no grant for that slot is in
flight.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a call has taken up a slot, that slot is booked for
exactly that call, so no two calls can ever have taken up the same shaft slot.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m1p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS RingSize, MaxGen, MaxFrames

Drones == 1..RingSize
Nowhere == 0
NextIn(d) == (d % RingSize) + 1

VARIABLES gen, tokenAt, believedGen, believes, crashed, frames

vars == <<gen, tokenAt, believedGen, believes, crashed, frames>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ tokenAt \in Drones \union {Nowhere}
    /\ believedGen \in [Drones -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ believes \subseteq Drones
    /\ crashed \subseteq Drones
    /\ frames \in 0..MaxFrames

TrueHolder(d) ==
    /\ d \in believes
    /\ believedGen[d] = gen
    /\ tokenAt = d
    /\ d \notin crashed

Init ==
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ tokenAt = 1
    /\ believedGen = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ believes = {1}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ frames = 0

PassToken(d) ==
    /\ TrueHolder(d)
    /\ tokenAt' = NextIn(d)
    /\ believes' = (believes \ {d}) \union {NextIn(d)}
    /\ believedGen' = [believedGen EXCEPT ![NextIn(d)] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, crashed, frames>>

Transmit(d) ==
    /\ TrueHolder(d)
    /\ frames < MaxFrames
    /\ frames' = frames + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, tokenAt, believedGen, believes, crashed>>

CrashSilently(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \union {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, tokenAt, believedGen, believes, frames>>

RegenerateToken(e) ==
    /\ tokenAt \in crashed
    /\ e \notin crashed
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ tokenAt' = e
    /\ believes' = believes \union {e}
    /\ believedGen' = [believedGen EXCEPT ![e] = gen + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, frames>>

GiveUpBelief(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ d \in believes
    /\ believedGen[d] < gen
    /\ believes' = believes \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, tokenAt, believedGen, crashed, frames>>

RestartDrone(d) ==
    /\ d \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {d}
    /\ believes' = IF believedGen[d] = gen THEN believes ELSE believes \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, tokenAt, believedGen, frames>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : PassToken(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Transmit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CrashSilently(d)
    \/ \E e \in Drones : RegenerateToken(e)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : GiveUpBelief(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : RestartDrone(d)

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A d \in Drones : SF_vars(GiveUpBelief(d))
    /\ \A d \in Drones : SF_vars(RestartDrone(d))

CurrentBelievers == {d \in Drones : d \in believes /\ believedGen[d] = gen}

OnlyRealHolderBelievesCurrent == CurrentBelievers \subseteq {tokenAt}

StaleBeliefEventuallyResolved ==
    \A d \in Drones :
        (d \in believes /\ believedGen[d] < gen)
            ~> (d \notin believes \/ believedGen[d] = gen)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    MaxGen = 2
    MaxFrames = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT OnlyRealHolderBelievesCurrent
PROPERTY StaleBeliefEventuallyResolved
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm flies in a fixed ring and shares the downlink
by passing a single token around that ring. The token has a generation number,
the swarm records which drone the token is actually at, and each drone separately
holds a belief about whether it has the token together with the generation of the
token it thinks it holds.

The token holder may transmit imagery only when it believes it holds the token,
the generation it believes is the swarm's current generation, the swarm really
does record the token as being at that drone, and the drone has not crashed. The
holder may pass the token to the next drone in the ring under the same
conditions; passing moves the recorded token, gives the next drone the belief and
the current generation, and takes the belief away from the passer.

A drone can crash silently. Nothing visible changes: it keeps its belief and its
generation, and if the token was recorded at it the token stays recorded there,
so the ring simply stops turning. When the token is stranded at a crashed drone,
ground control regenerates it: the generation advances and the token is recorded
at a chosen uncrashed drone, which is given the belief at the new generation. The
stranded drone's own belief is deliberately left alone, so it is left believing it
holds a token of a generation that no longer exists.

A drone whose believed generation is behind the swarm's current generation and
which has not crashed gives up its belief. A crashed drone can be restarted, and
on restart it gives up any belief that is not at the current generation.

The complete set of actions is: pass the token to the next drone in the ring,
transmit imagery as the true current holder, crash a drone silently, regenerate
the token onto an uncrashed drone when it is stranded at a crashed one, have a
running drone with a behind-the-times belief give that belief up, and restart a
crashed drone.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of drones that believe they hold a token of the swarm's
current generation is always contained in the single-element set naming the drone
the token is actually recorded at, so a stranded or superseded drone can never
pass the check that guards transmitting.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: a drone left believing it holds a token of a superseded
generation is eventually put right, either by giving that belief up or by being
handed a token of the current generation.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m7p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Controllers, Blocks, MaxVersion

NoWriter == "nowriter"
Interlocking == "interlocking"

VARIABLES reg, inflight, writerOf, rejected

vars == <<reg, inflight, writerOf, rejected>>

Proposals == [by : Controllers, block : Blocks, version : 0..MaxVersion]

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in [locked : SUBSET Blocks, version : 0..MaxVersion]
    /\ inflight \subseteq Proposals
    /\ writerOf \in [1..MaxVersion -> Controllers \union {Interlocking, NoWriter}]
    /\ rejected \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ reg = [locked |-> {}, version |-> 0]
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ writerOf = [v \in 1..MaxVersion |-> NoWriter]
    /\ rejected = {}

ProposeBlock(c, b) ==
    /\ \A m \in inflight : m.by # c
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union
                    {[by |-> c, block |-> b, version |-> reg.version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, writerOf, rejected>>

ApplyProposal(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ m.version = reg.version
    /\ m.version < MaxVersion
    /\ reg' = [locked |-> reg.locked \union {m.block},
               version |-> m.version + 1]
    /\ writerOf' = [writerOf EXCEPT ![m.version + 1] = m.by]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED rejected

RejectProposal(m) ==
    /\ m \in inflight
    /\ \/ m.version # reg.version
       \/ reg.version = MaxVersion
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {m}
    /\ rejected' = rejected \union {m.by}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, writerOf>>

ReleaseBlock(b) ==
    /\ b \in reg.locked
    /\ reg.version < MaxVersion
    /\ reg' = [locked |-> reg.locked \ {b}, version |-> reg.version + 1]
    /\ writerOf' = [writerOf EXCEPT ![reg.version + 1] = Interlocking]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, rejected>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, b \in Blocks : ProposeBlock(c, b)
    \/ \E m \in Proposals : ApplyProposal(m)
    \/ \E m \in Proposals : RejectProposal(m)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : ReleaseBlock(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WriteHistoryHasNoGap ==
    \A v \in 1..reg.version : writerOf[v] # NoWriter

====
nl:
A subway signalling block system keeps its shared record, the set of track blocks
currently locked, in a single compare-and-swap register. The register carries the
locked set together with a version number. Alongside the register the system
keeps a write history: for each version number it records who performed the write
that produced it, or records that nothing produced it yet.

Interlocking controllers ask for a block by putting a proposal on the network. A
proposal names the controller, the block it wants, and the register version the
controller read when it built the proposal. A controller may have at most one
proposal in flight, and it may ask for any block at all. The network gives no
ordering guarantee, so proposals sit in flight and are taken up in whatever order
the interlocking gets to them; a block a controller wanted may well already be
locked by the time its proposal is taken up, in which case applying the proposal
simply leaves that block locked.

Taking up a proposal is a compare-and-swap. The proposal is applied only if the
version it carries is still the register's version and the version counter has
room left; applying adds the block to the locked set, sets the register's version
to one past the version the proposal carried, and records the proposing
controller as the writer of that new version. A proposal whose version no longer
matches, or that arrives when the version counter is exhausted, is rejected and
its proposing controller is noted as having been rejected.

The interlocking itself can release a locked block. A release also writes the
register: it removes the block from the locked set, advances the version by one,
and records the interlocking as the writer of that new version.

The complete set of actions is: put a proposal for a block on the network, apply a proposal whose version still matches, reject a proposal that no
longer qualifies, and release a locked block as the interlocking.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every version number from one up to the register's current
version has a writer recorded against it, so the write history has no gap and no
accepted write has ever been overwritten by a proposal built on a version that
had already moved on.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m9p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Bags, Lanes, PerLane, MaxEpoch

Outside == "outside"
Riding == "riding"
Aside == "aside"
Delivered == "delivered"

VARIABLES epoch, activeLanes, place, seized

vars == <<epoch, activeLanes, place, seized>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ activeLanes \subseteq Lanes
    /\ place \in [Bags -> {Outside, Riding, Aside, Delivered}]
    /\ seized \in BOOLEAN

RidingCount == Cardinality({b \in Bags : place[b] = Riding})
CapacityOf(ls) == Cardinality(ls) * PerLane

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ activeLanes = Lanes
    /\ place = [b \in Bags |-> Outside]
    /\ seized = FALSE

AdmitBag(b) ==
    /\ place[b] = Outside
    /\ RidingCount + 1 <= CapacityOf(activeLanes)
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![b] = Riding]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, seized>>

DeliverBag(b) ==
    /\ place[b] = Riding
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![b] = Delivered]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, seized>>

RecycleBag(b) ==
    /\ place[b] = Delivered
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![b] = Outside]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, seized>>

Reconfigure(ls) ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ ls # activeLanes
    /\ RidingCount <= CapacityOf(ls)
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ activeLanes' = ls
    /\ UNCHANGED <<place, seized>>

SeizeRouter ==
    /\ ~seized
    /\ seized' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, place>>

ReleaseRouter ==
    /\ seized
    /\ seized' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, place>>

ForceLaneSet(ls) ==
    /\ seized
    /\ activeLanes' = ls
    /\ place' = [b \in Bags |-> IF place[b] = Riding THEN Aside ELSE place[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seized>>

LetBackIn(b) ==
    /\ place[b] = Aside
    /\ RidingCount + 1 <= CapacityOf(activeLanes)
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![b] = Riding]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, activeLanes, seized>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags : AdmitBag(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : DeliverBag(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : RecycleBag(b)
    \/ \E ls \in SUBSET Lanes : Reconfigure(ls)
    \/ SeizeRouter
    \/ ReleaseRouter
    \/ \E ls \in SUBSET Lanes : ForceLaneSet(ls)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : LetBackIn(b)

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A b \in Bags : SF_vars(DeliverBag(b))

RouterWithinLaneCapacity == RidingCount <= CapacityOf(activeLanes)

RidingBagEventuallyLeaves ==
    \A b \in Bags : (place[b] = Riding) ~> (place[b] # Riding)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Bags = {g1, g2}
    Lanes = {l1, l2}
    PerLane = 1
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT RouterWithinLaneCapacity
PROPERTY RidingBagEventuallyLeaves
nl:
An airport baggage router moves bags across a set of sorting lanes. The set of
lanes that are in service is decided by epoch-numbered reconfiguration: the
router holds an epoch number and the active lane set, and each lane can carry a
fixed number of bags, so the router's carrying capacity is the number of active
lanes times that per-lane figure. Every bag is in exactly one state: outside the
router, riding inside the router, held aside on the overflow spur, or delivered.

A bag that is outside can be admitted into the router as long as the bags already
riding inside, plus that one, are still within the current carrying capacity. A
bag riding inside can be delivered. A delivered bag can be recycled back to the
outside state so it can travel again.

A normal reconfiguration advances the epoch and installs a new active lane set,
but only if the bags currently riding inside would still be within the carrying
capacity that the new lane set implies; a reconfiguration that would leave the
router over capacity is simply not available. Normal reconfiguration is blocked
while the duty manager has seized the router.

The duty manager holds a privileged override. The manager can seize the router
and release it again. While the router is seized, the manager can force any lane
set into service without advancing the epoch at all; because a forced
installation ignores the capacity arithmetic, it first sweeps every bag riding
inside the router onto the overflow spur, so the router is empty at the moment
the new lane set takes effect. A bag on the overflow spur can be let back into
the router whenever the current capacity has room for it.

The complete set of actions is: admit an outside bag into the router, deliver a
bag riding inside, recycle a delivered bag back to the outside, reconfigure
normally with an epoch advance, seize the router as duty manager, release the
router, force a lane set into service by override while sweeping the router onto
the overflow spur, and let a bag back in from the overflow spur.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of bags riding inside the router never exceeds the
number of active lanes times the per-lane bag figure, through every normal
reconfiguration and every forced override installation.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every bag that is riding inside the router eventually stops
riding inside it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m8p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Desks, Parties, MaxSeq

FreeLock == "free"
NoReservation == [party |-> "noparty", seq |-> 0]

VARIABLES batchLock, posLock, applied, cursor, reservation

vars == <<batchLock, posLock, applied, cursor, reservation>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ batchLock \in Desks \union {FreeLock}
    /\ posLock \in [Parties -> Desks \union {FreeLock}]
    /\ applied \in [Parties -> SUBSET (1..MaxSeq)]
    /\ cursor \in [Parties -> 0..MaxSeq]
    /\ reservation \in [Desks -> {NoReservation} \union
                                 [party : Parties, seq : 1..MaxSeq]]

HoldsAFineLock(d) == \E p \in Parties : posLock[p] = d

Init ==
    /\ batchLock = FreeLock
    /\ posLock = [p \in Parties |-> FreeLock]
    /\ applied = [p \in Parties |-> {}]
    /\ cursor = [p \in Parties |-> 0]
    /\ reservation = [d \in Desks |-> NoReservation]

TakeBatchLock(d) ==
    /\ batchLock = FreeLock
    /\ reservation[d] = NoReservation
    /\ batchLock' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<posLock, applied, cursor, reservation>>

ReserveNext(d, p) ==
    /\ batchLock = d
    /\ posLock[p] = FreeLock
    /\ reservation[d] = NoReservation
    /\ cursor[p] < MaxSeq
    /\ posLock' = [posLock EXCEPT ![p] = d]
    /\ reservation' = [reservation EXCEPT ![d] =
                        [party |-> p, seq |-> cursor[p] + 1]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, applied, cursor>>

ApplyReservation(d) ==
    /\ reservation[d] # NoReservation
    /\ posLock[reservation[d].party] = d
    /\ reservation[d].seq = cursor[reservation[d].party] + 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![reservation[d].party] =
                    applied[reservation[d].party] \union {reservation[d].seq}]
    /\ cursor' = [cursor EXCEPT ![reservation[d].party] = reservation[d].seq]
    /\ posLock' = [posLock EXCEPT ![reservation[d].party] = FreeLock]
    /\ reservation' = [reservation EXCEPT ![d] = NoReservation]
    /\ UNCHANGED batchLock

AbandonReservation(d) ==
    /\ reservation[d] # NoReservation
    /\ reservation[d].seq # cursor[reservation[d].party] + 1
    /\ posLock' = [posLock EXCEPT ![reservation[d].party] = FreeLock]
    /\ reservation' = [reservation EXCEPT ![d] = NoReservation]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, applied, cursor>>

DropBatchLock(d) ==
    /\ batchLock = d
    /\ reservation[d] = NoReservation
    /\ ~HoldsAFineLock(d)
    /\ batchLock' = FreeLock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<posLock, applied, cursor, reservation>>

AdminMergeNext(p) ==
    /\ cursor[p] < MaxSeq
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![p] = applied[p] \union {cursor[p] + 1}]
    /\ cursor' = [cursor EXCEPT ![p] = cursor[p] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batchLock, posLock, reservation>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Desks : TakeBatchLock(d)
    \/ \E d \in Desks, p \in Parties : ReserveNext(d, p)
    \/ \E d \in Desks : ApplyReservation(d)
    \/ \E d \in Desks : AbandonReservation(d)
    \/ \E d \in Desks : DropBatchLock(d)
    \/ \E p \in Parties : AdminMergeNext(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AppliedSetIsExactRun == \A p \in Parties : applied[p] = 1..cursor[p]

====
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch maintains one shared record per counterparty:
the set of numbered adjustments that have been merged into that counterparty's
net position, together with a cursor giving the highest adjustment number the
position is known to have taken. Access is protected by hierarchical locks: one
coarse lock on the whole batch, and inside it a fine lock on each counterparty's
position.

A desk with no reservation outstanding takes the batch's coarse lock. Holding the
coarse lock and carrying no reservation, a desk takes the fine lock on a
counterparty whose cursor has room left and in the same step reserves that
counterparty's next adjustment number, computed as one past the cursor. The fine
lock stays held across the reservation.

Applying is the step that writes: the desk merges its reserved adjustment number
into the counterparty's applied set, moves that counterparty's cursor up to the
number just applied, and releases the fine lock. A desk may only apply while its
reserved number is still exactly one past the counterparty's cursor; if the
cursor has moved on underneath it, the reservation is stale and the desk must
abandon it instead, releasing the fine lock and writing nothing. A desk holding
the coarse lock with no reservation and no fine lock can drop the coarse lock.

The settlement administrator holds a privileged override: the administrator can
merge a counterparty's next adjustment number straight into its applied set and
move its cursor up, ignoring both the coarse lock and the fine lock entirely. This
is exactly what can leave a desk's reservation stale.

The complete set of actions is: take the batch's coarse lock, take a
counterparty's fine lock and reserve its next adjustment number, apply a
reservation that is still exactly one past the cursor, abandon a stale
reservation, drop the coarse lock, and merge a counterparty's next adjustment by
administrator override.

SAFETY PROPERTY: for every counterparty the set of adjustment numbers merged into
its position is exactly the run of numbers from one up to its cursor, so no
adjustment below the cursor has ever been lost by one writer overwriting
another's work.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m0p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Bays, MaxVersion

Controllers == {"north", "south"}
NoRead == [free |-> {}, version |-> -1]

VARIABLES pool, readOf, granted, retried

vars == <<pool, readOf, granted, retried>>

Reads == {NoRead} \union [free : SUBSET Bays, version : 0..MaxVersion]

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in [free : SUBSET Bays, version : 0..MaxVersion]
    /\ readOf \in [north : Reads, south : Reads]
    /\ granted \in [north : SUBSET Bays, south : SUBSET Bays]
    /\ retried \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ pool = [free |-> Bays, version |-> 0]
    /\ readOf = [north |-> NoRead, south |-> NoRead]
    /\ granted = [north |-> {}, south |-> {}]
    /\ retried = {}

ReadPool(i) ==
    /\ readOf[i] = NoRead
    /\ readOf' = [readOf EXCEPT ![i] = pool]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, granted, retried>>

ClaimBay(i, b) ==
    /\ readOf[i] # NoRead
    /\ readOf[i].version = pool.version
    /\ pool.version < MaxVersion
    /\ b \in readOf[i].free
    /\ pool' = [free |-> pool.free \ {b}, version |-> pool.version + 1]
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![i] = granted[i] \union {b}]
    /\ readOf' = [readOf EXCEPT ![i] = NoRead]
    /\ UNCHANGED retried

DiscardRead(i) ==
    /\ readOf[i] # NoRead
    /\ \/ readOf[i].version # pool.version
       \/ readOf[i].free = {}
       \/ pool.version = MaxVersion
    /\ readOf' = [readOf EXCEPT ![i] = NoRead]
    /\ retried' = retried \union {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, granted>>

ReleaseBay(i, b) ==
    /\ b \in granted[i]
    /\ pool.version < MaxVersion
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![i] = granted[i] \ {b}]
    /\ pool' = [free |-> pool.free \union {b}, version |-> pool.version + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<readOf, retried>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Controllers : ReadPool(i)
    \/ \E i \in Controllers, b \in Bays : ClaimBay(i, b)
    \/ \E i \in Controllers : DiscardRead(i)
    \/ \E i \in Controllers, b \in Bays : ReleaseBay(i, b)

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A i \in Controllers : SF_vars(\E b \in Bays : ClaimBay(i, b))
    /\ \A i \in Controllers : SF_vars(DiscardRead(i))

NoBayGrantedTwice == granted.north \cap granted.south = {}

ReadEventuallyResolved ==
    \A i \in Controllers : (readOf[i] # NoRead) ~> (readOf[i] = NoRead)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Bays = {b1, b2}
    MaxVersion = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoBayGrantedTwice
PROPERTY ReadEventuallyResolved
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is run by two independent control instances, the north
aisle controller and the south aisle controller, which share one pool of charging
bays. The pool is published as a register holding the set of bays currently free
together with a version number, and every write to the register bumps the version
until the version counter is exhausted. Each controller keeps its own set of bays
it has been granted.

A controller with no read outstanding reads the pool register, keeping both the
free set and the version it saw. It then tries to claim one of the bays its read
showed as free. The claim is optimistic: it lands only if the version the
controller read is still the register's current version, which is what stops the
two independent controllers from both spending the same free bay out of the same
stale picture. A landed claim removes the bay from the register's free set, bumps
the version, and adds the bay to the claiming controller's granted set.

A controller discards its read and starts over when the version has moved on,
when its read showed no free bays at all, or when the version counter is
exhausted so no claim could be written; a controller that has had to start over
is noted as having retried. A controller can release one of its granted bays,
which takes the bay out of that controller's granted set and puts it back into
the register's free set with another versioned write.

The complete set of actions is: read the pool register, optimistically claim a
bay that the read showed free while the version still matches, discard a stale,
empty or unwritable read, and release a granted bay back into the pool.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the north controller's granted bays and the south controller's
granted bays never overlap, so the two independent instances are never both
allocated the same charging bay.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: a controller that has a read outstanding eventually resolves
it, either by landing a claim or by discarding the read.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m6p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS Operators, TotalSheets, LeaseSpan, MaxCapacity

NoOperator == "nooperator"

VARIABLES store, tray, printed, spoiled, lease, capacity

vars == <<store, tray, printed, spoiled, lease, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ store \in 0..TotalSheets
    /\ tray \in 0..TotalSheets
    /\ printed \in 0..TotalSheets
    /\ spoiled \in 0..TotalSheets
    /\ lease \in [holder : Operators \union {NoOperator}, ticks : 0..LeaseSpan]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCapacity

LeaseRunning == lease.holder # NoOperator /\ lease.ticks > 0

Init ==
    /\ store = TotalSheets
    /\ tray = 0
    /\ printed = 0
    /\ spoiled = 0
    /\ lease = [holder |-> NoOperator, ticks |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = MaxCapacity

GrantLease(o) ==
    /\ lease.holder = NoOperator
    /\ lease' = [holder |-> o, ticks |-> LeaseSpan]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, tray, printed, spoiled, capacity>>

TickLease ==
    /\ lease.ticks > 0
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT !.ticks = lease.ticks - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, tray, printed, spoiled, capacity>>

DropExpiredLease ==
    /\ lease.holder # NoOperator
    /\ lease.ticks = 0
    /\ lease' = [holder |-> NoOperator, ticks |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, tray, printed, spoiled, capacity>>

DrawSheet ==
    /\ LeaseRunning
    /\ store > 0
    /\ store' = store - 1
    /\ tray' = tray + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<printed, spoiled, lease, capacity>>

PrintSheet ==
    /\ tray > 0
    /\ tray' = tray - 1
    /\ printed' = printed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, spoiled, lease, capacity>>

ReturnSheet ==
    /\ tray > 0
    /\ store + 1 <= capacity
    /\ tray' = tray - 1
    /\ store' = store + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<printed, spoiled, lease, capacity>>

SpoilSheet ==
    /\ tray > 0
    /\ store + 1 > capacity
    /\ tray' = tray - 1
    /\ spoiled' = spoiled + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, printed, lease, capacity>>

SetCapacity(k) ==
    /\ k # capacity
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<store, tray, printed, spoiled, lease>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Operators : GrantLease(o)
    \/ TickLease
    \/ DropExpiredLease
    \/ DrawSheet
    \/ PrintSheet
    \/ ReturnSheet
    \/ SpoilSheet
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCapacity : SetCapacity(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SheetsConserved == store + tray + printed + spoiled = TotalSheets

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Operators = {o1, o2}
    TotalSheets = 3
    LeaseSpan = 2
    MaxCapacity = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT SheetsConserved
nl:
A print shop job spooler tracks every sheet of paper the shop owns. Each sheet is
in exactly one of four places at any instant: in the paper store, in the tray of
whoever currently holds the store's lease, already printed, or spoiled.

Access to the store is by lease. A lease names an operator and carries a number
of ticks left to run; when no operator holds the lease, any operator can be
granted it with a full span of ticks. A tick of the shop clock runs one tick off
a lease that still has ticks left, and a lease that has run out of ticks can be
dropped, freeing the lease for the next operator.

While holding a lease that still has ticks left, an operator can draw a sheet out
of the store into its tray. A sheet in the tray can be printed, which moves it
into the printed total. A sheet in the tray can instead be returned to the store,
but only if the store's occupancy after the return would still be within the
store's current shelf capacity. A tray sheet that the store cannot take back
because it is at or over capacity is spoiled instead.

The shop's shelf capacity changes at runtime as racking is added or pulled out.
Capacity governs returns only: shrinking it never throws sheets out of the store,
it only blocks sheets from coming back.

The complete set of actions is: grant the store lease to an operator, tick a
running lease down, drop a lease that has run out, draw a sheet from the store
into the tray, print a tray sheet, return a tray sheet to the store when capacity
allows, spoil a tray sheet that capacity will not take back, and set the shelf
capacity to a new value.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the sheets in the store, the sheets in the tray, the sheets
already printed, and the sheets spoiled always sum to exactly the shop's total
sheet count, so no lease expiry or capacity change ever creates or destroys a
sheet.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m9p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Units, Fridges, MaxSlots, MaxEpoch

Bench == "bench"
WrittenOff == "writtenoff"
Away == "away"

VARIABLES epoch, commissioned, place, slotFigure

vars == <<epoch, commissioned, place, slotFigure>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ commissioned \subseteq Fridges
    /\ place \in [Units -> Fridges \union {Bench, WrittenOff, Away}]
    /\ slotFigure \in 0..MaxSlots

Inside(f) == Cardinality({u \in Units : place[u] = f})
AllowedIn(f) == IF f \in commissioned THEN slotFigure ELSE 0

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ commissioned = Fridges
    /\ place = [u \in Units |-> Away]
    /\ slotFigure = MaxSlots

Reconfigure(cs) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ cs # commissioned
    /\ \A f \in Fridges : f \notin cs => Inside(f) = 0
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ commissioned' = cs
    /\ UNCHANGED <<place, slotFigure>>

SetSlotFigure(k) ==
    /\ k # slotFigure
    /\ \A f \in commissioned : Inside(f) <= k
    /\ slotFigure' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, place>>

AcceptUnit(u, f) ==
    /\ place[u] = Away
    /\ f \in commissioned
    /\ Inside(f) < slotFigure
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![u] = f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, slotFigure>>

PullToBench(u) ==
    /\ place[u] \in Fridges
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![u] = Bench]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, slotFigure>>

PlaceFromBench(u, f) ==
    /\ place[u] = Bench
    /\ f \in commissioned
    /\ Inside(f) < slotFigure
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![u] = f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, slotFigure>>

WriteOffUnit(u) ==
    /\ place[u] = Bench
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![u] = WrittenOff]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, slotFigure>>

ClearWrittenOff(u) ==
    /\ place[u] = WrittenOff
    /\ place' = [place EXCEPT ![u] = Away]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, commissioned, slotFigure>>

Next ==
    \/ \E cs \in SUBSET Fridges : Reconfigure(cs)
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxSlots : SetSlotFigure(k)
    \/ \E u \in Units, f \in Fridges : AcceptUnit(u, f)
    \/ \E u \in Units : PullToBench(u)
    \/ \E u \in Units, f \in Fridges : PlaceFromBench(u, f)
    \/ \E u \in Units : WriteOffUnit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Units : ClearWrittenOff(u)

Spec ==
    /\ Init
    /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ \A u \in Units : SF_vars(WriteOffUnit(u))

FridgeWithinItsAllowance == \A f \in Fridges : Inside(f) <= AllowedIn(f)

BenchUnitEventuallyLeaves ==
    \A u \in Units : (place[u] = Bench) ~> (place[u] # Bench)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Units = {u1, u2}
    Fridges = {f1, f2}
    MaxSlots = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT FridgeWithinItsAllowance
PROPERTY BenchUnitEventuallyLeaves
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps its units in a set of refrigerators. Which
refrigerators are commissioned is decided by epoch-numbered reconfiguration: the
tracker holds an epoch number and the set of commissioned refrigerators, and each
commissioned refrigerator can hold up to a per-fridge slot figure. That slot
figure itself changes at runtime as shelving is swapped in and out, so capacity
moves in two independent ways. Every unit is in exactly one place: inside some
refrigerator, held on the bench, written off, or outside the bank altogether.

A reconfiguration advances the epoch and installs a new commissioned set, but it
is only available when every refrigerator being decommissioned is already empty,
so units are never stranded in a fridge that has left service. The slot figure
can be set to a new value, but only when every commissioned refrigerator's
current contents would still fit inside the new figure.

A unit from outside can be accepted into a commissioned refrigerator that has a
slot free. A unit inside a refrigerator can be pulled out onto the bench. A unit
on the bench can be placed into any commissioned refrigerator with a slot free,
or can be written off. A written-off unit can be cleared back to outside the
bank.

The complete set of actions is: reconfigure the commissioned set with an epoch
advance, set the per-fridge slot figure, accept an outside unit into a
commissioned refrigerator, pull a unit out of a refrigerator onto the bench,
place a bench unit into a commissioned refrigerator, write off a bench unit, and
clear a written-off unit back to outside.

SAFETY PROPERTY: for every refrigerator, the number of units inside it is at most
its per-fridge slot figure if it is commissioned and is zero if it is not, so
neither a reconfiguration nor a change of the slot figure ever leaves a
refrigerator holding more than it is allowed to.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every unit sitting on the bench eventually leaves the bench.
